title: Apple Unveils New Apple TV 4K with Siri AI: Features, Specs, Release Date, and Bangladesh Update
summary: The new Apple TV 4K 2026 adds Siri AI, an A19 chip, three far-field mics, and AV1 support. It goes on sale November 13 for $299 in the US. Learn the specs, upgrades, and Bangladesh availability news.
intro: Apple TV 4K 2026 brings Siri AI, an A19 chip, and hands-free voice control. See what's new here.
html:
On October 13, 2026, the company announced the new Apple TV 4K (4th generation). When Apple unveiled the new Apple TV 4K hardware, it attracted people for many good reasons. It comes packed with a smarter Siri, a faster chip, and better sound. If you love movies, shows, games, or smart home gadgets, this one deserves a close look for you.

Here is everything you need to know about the latest Apple TV 4K (4th generation) and how it stacks up against the older model. We'll also share what buyers in Bangladesh should know before it lands in local shops.

Table of Contents

  • What Is the New Apple TV 4K?
  • Apple TV 4K Features & Specifications
  • New Apple TV 4K Release Date and Price
  • Apple TV 4K Price & Availability in Bangladesh
  • How Does the New Apple TV 4K Compare to the Previous Version?
  • Should You Buy the New Apple TV 4K?

What Is the New Apple TV 4K?

The 4th Gen Apple TV 4K is Apple's latest streaming TV box in 2026. It runs on the A19 chip, adds three built-in far-field microphones for hands-free Siri, and brings Siri AI, a fully rebuilt Siri powered by Apple Intelligence. Pre-orders opened on October 13, 2026, and the device goes on sale November 13 for $299 in the US.

Apple TV 4K Features & Specifications

Let's break down each feature one at a time.

New Siri AI Assistant

Siri AI is the headline feature. Apple calls it an entirely new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence, and it shows up as a full-screen experience on your TV. You can talk to it naturally, ask follow-up questions, and get smart answers, not just simple commands. With an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone, a request like "Play the show Alinda recommended" actually works.

The new Siri AI controls your smart home too, so you can dim lights or switch scenes hands-free. It launches as a beta in English only, starting in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, India, New Zealand, Singapore, and South Africa. Bangladesh is not listed among the initial Siri AI launch markets in Apple’s announcement, so local users may need to wait.

Built-in Far-Field Microphones

For the first time, the box itself can hear you. Three far-field microphones let you control Apple TV 4K completely hands-free. Just say "Siri" or "Hey Siri" to start a show, play music, or turn off the lights. Advanced echo cancellation intelligently isolates a user's voice from background sound for voice recognition, even while audio is playing. 

So even with an action movie at full volume, Siri can still pick out your words. Note that far-field mic support depends on your tvOS language.

Advanced Apple A19 Chip

The A19 chip now powers everything under the hood. Menus feel snappier, apps open faster, and animations look smoother. Games get a boost too, which matters if you play Apple Arcade titles with a controller. The chip also handles privacy. Secure Enclaves process microphone data separately from the rest of the system, so not even Apple can access it.

Dedicated AV1 Decoder

The A19 chip now includes a dedicated AV1 decoder. So the new Apple TV 4K streams high-quality video for you while using less bandwidth. That's good news for homes with slower or shared internet, which is very common in Bangladesh. Less buffering and sharper pictures make a real difference on a big screen, and Dolby Vision with HDR10+ keeps 4K picture quality looking great.

New Siri Remote Features

The new Apple TV 4K remote features solve a familiar problem: losing the remote on the couch. Apple kept the same design but added Find My support with precision finding, so a supported Apple device can point you right to it.

Or just say "Siri, find the remote," and Apple TV 4K plays sound on the new remote so you can follow the beep. Note that older Siri Remote models support Find My, but Precision Finding and the new play-sound feature are tied to the newest remote features Apple announced that require an iPhone Air, iPhone Duo, or iPhone 17 or later (not iPhone 17e). Apple also sells the remote separately, and it works with Apple TV HD and older Apple TV 4K models.

New Home Theater Experience

The new Apple TV 4K with enhanced home theater features brings something new to your living room. For the first time, you can enjoy three-dimensional surround sound by pairing the new Apple TV 4K with four HomePod mini 2 speakers for a full home theater setup.

Place two speakers in the front and two in the rear. Apple TV 4K intelligently recognizes speaker position in the space, then automatically adjusts timing and volume for room-filling, cinematic sound, with no manual tuning needed. For the ultimate audio experience, you can also use HomePod (2nd generation) in this setup, as long as front and rear pairs match.

New Screen Saver

Screen savers on Apple TV have always been a fan favorite, and now you get more control. With an iPhone or iPad, you can set up a customized iCloud Photo Showcase that shows only the photos you pick. Choose memories & slideshows or portraits without putting your whole library on display. That's handy when guests come over. There is also a new shuffle option that rotates between screen saver categories on its own.

Private Cloud Compute Feature

Privacy sits at the core of Siri AI. Some Siri requests run right on the device, while others use Private Cloud Compute for heavier tasks. Private Cloud Compute extends your device's privacy to Apple's servers, so your data is never stored or made available to Apple or anyone else.

As a result, your home camera footage stays safe as well. HomeKit Secure Video clips are end-to-end encrypted, and Apple can't see them.

New Apple TV 4K Release Date and Price

The Apple TV 4K launch date is Friday, November 13, 2026. That's when the device reaches stores in the US and 29 other countries and regions. Pre-orders opened right after the announcement on October 13 through Apple's online store and the Apple Store app.

  • Announcement: October 13, 2026

  • Pre-orders: October 13, 2026

  • Apple TV 4K release date: November 13, 2026

  • US price: $299, or $49.83 per month for six months with Apple Card Monthly Installments

When you weigh the Apple TV 4K features and price together, $299 sits well above older models. Still, you get a smarter assistant, built-in mics, a faster chip, and a home theater upgrade in one small box.

Apple TV 4K Price & Availability in Bangladesh

Apple has not announced an official price for Bangladesh yet. Since Apple does not run its own stores here, new devices usually arrive through local retailers a few weeks after the global launch. Expect the local price to land above a direct dollar conversion once import costs and duties are added.

Fake and gray-market gadgets are a real risk, so buy from a trusted seller. Star Tech is a solid name to watch, and following their online shop is an easy way to know when authentic Apple TV 4K stock arrives in Bangladesh.

How Does the New Apple TV 4K Compare to the Previous Version?

The Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) launched in 2022 and still runs well today. But the 4th generation model brings changes you will notice right away. Here's a side-by-side look.

Feature Apple TV 4K (4th Gen, 2026) Apple TV 4K (3rd Gen, 2022)
Chip A19 A15 Bionic
Siri Siri AI (beta) Siri AI (beta) via software update
Built-in Microphones Three far-field mics None (remote mic only)
AV1 Hardware Decoding Yes, dedicated decoder No
Four-Speaker HomePod Surround Yes No
Remote Find My, Precision Finding, and play sound Find My support, no Precision Finding or play sound
Thread Support Built in Wi-Fi + Ethernet model only
Storage Not announced 64GB or 128GB
Wi-Fi Built-in Wi-Fi Wi-Fi 6
HDR Formats Dolby Vision, HDR10+ Dolby Vision, HDR10+
Launch Price (US) $299 $129 (Wi-Fi), $149 (Wi-Fi + Ethernet)

Performance

Speed is the biggest jump. The A19 chip delivers up to 50 percent faster CPU performance and up to 2x faster GPU performance than the previous generation. In daily use, that means quicker app launches, smoother menus, and better gaming.

Voice and Smart Features

Older models rely on the remote's mic for Siri. Siri AI beta is also available on Apple TV 4K 2nd generation and later, subject to Apple’s setup, device, and language requirements, but only the 4th generation gives you true hands-free control.

Sound and Streaming

Four-speaker HomePod surround sound and AV1 decoding are exclusive to the new model. If you stream a lot or plan to build a home theater, these two upgrades alone make a strong case.

Should You Buy the New Apple TV 4K?

Owners of the 3rd generation model who mostly watch shows can hold off for now. Anyone with an Apple TV HD or an older 4K model, or anyone who wants hands-free Siri and better sound, will feel the difference right away.

For buyers in Bangladesh, the smart move is to wait for official local stock and buy from a trusted retailer. Keep an eye on Star Tech's online shop for the authentic Apple TV 4K once it lands. Until then, this guide has everything you need to decide if Apple TV 4K 2026 belongs in your home.
